test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner, and one differs from these in that manner. Select the ODD figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94fc088edcf08ee567af1614accc14c588d0f9897488c9efc077f2e9fa78c291.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** In figures **1, 2, 4, and 5**, the letters follow a consistent alphabetical progression where each letter increases by **+3 positions** in the alphabet (cyclically). This maintains a uniform forward stepping pattern across all valid figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94fc088edcf08ee567af1614accc14c588d0f9897488c9efc077f2e9fa78c291.png] 

Now, checking the Options:

**Option 1 (P, S, V):** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d41f76472958c765810d863dbf4c91589c89f1502ad2f3b59c329dd6b2390860.png] 

P → S (+3), S → V (+3) → Follows the rule

Option 2 (T, W, Z): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/453590648ad17fe3141c55f83830be8fa1e14e149ce0e131bfa86b4e9dec0ce6.png] 
T → W (+3), W → Z (+3) → Follows the rule

Option 3 (Y, U, R): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bb83edc9561fd44d1434558fa86782027578a99a4545df7b0366f6e2d2a26fb.png] 
Y → U (-4), U → R (-3) → Does not follow the +3 forward progression → Breaks the rule → Odd one out

Option** 4 (J, M, P):** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42c123c97b25941938f26db2c06e6a22675cebda42eb3991cc550466927568b3.png] 

J → M (+3), M → P (+3) → Follows the rule

Hence, Option 3 is the odd figure out.
